identifiers.identifier_scope: Investigational radiopharmaceutical / targeted alpha therapy construct

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: 225Ac-FAPI-XT is an investigational targeted alpha radiopharmaceutical that binds fibroblast activation protein (FAP) expressed on cancer-associated fibroblasts and delivers actinium-225 alpha-particle radiation to the tumor microenvironment.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Ligand-mediated binding to FAP followed by localized emission of high-linear-energy-transfer alpha radiation from actinium-225 and its daughters, causing DNA damage and cell death in targeted stromal and nearby tumor cells.
downstream_effects: Radiation-induced cell death in FAP-expressing stromal cells
Cross-fire irradiation of adjacent tumor cells
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Designed to target FAP-expressing tumor stroma; exact human selectivity profile for the XT construct not established in the retrieved literature.

typical_use.cancer: Solid tumors with FAP-avid disease on imaging
typical_use.scope: Not approved; reported as an experimental FAP-targeted alpha therapy approach.

data_notes.record_scope: Publicly identifiable information for 225Ac-FAPI-XT appears limited and largely investigational/preclinical or early translational. Quantitative human efficacy and PK fields are left null/empty where not firmly documented.
